name: UpdateAllEmailProperties
description: Updates multiple properties of an email message in a Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox, including read status, flag status, categories, and importance.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access mailbox data through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: Mailbox address containing the email message. Leave empty to use the authenticated user's mailbox.

fields.name: MessageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the email message to update.

fields.name: IsRead
fields.label: Is Read
fields.description: Marks the email as read (true) or unread (false).

fields.name: FlagStatus
fields.label: Flag Status
fields.description: Specifies the flag status of the email. Options include 'flagged' or 'notFlagged'.

fields.name: Categories
fields.label: Categories
fields.description: List of categories to assign to the email.

fields.name: Importance
fields.label: Importance
fields.description: Sets the priority level of the email.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the status of the update operation and the updated email properties.
